thread:
hao: Quick heads-up — CLDR boundary tests for the new oasis-v2 model show weird splits when locale fallback triggers (zh -> en). Ran the locale-suite with --cldr-fallback and saw token boundary shifts in mixed-script strings.

sophia: Can you paste the failing example? :eyes:

hao: Sure — input and outputs:
```
input: "上海-市?Mr. 李 (U.K.)" locale_chain: [zh, en]
gold: "上海市 Mr. 李 (英国)"
model: "上海 - 市 ? Mr . 李 (U . K . )"
```
Tokenization inserts spaces around punctuation and ascii sequences. BLEU drops ~3.1 on the zh->en subset.

raj: Is this the quantized int4 build or fp16 bring-up?

hao: int4 q8x2 runway. Also repros on fp16 but magnitude smaller (~0.8 BLEU). So quant kernels amplify the issue.

elaine: Any tracing data? Maybe CLDR normalization step is being applied after tokenization, causing mismatch.

hao: Trace shows locale normalization (NFKC + CLDR locale mappings) applied in pipeline before tokenization. But when fallback to en occurs, a different mapping set runs and we get ascii-run segmentation. Here's the quick dump:
```
pre_norm(zh): "上海-市?Mr. 李 (U.K.)" -> "上海-市?Mr. 李 (英国)"
fallback_norm(en): "上海-市?Mr. 李 (U.K.)" -> "上海 - 市 ? Mr . 李 (U . K . )"
```

sophia: Interesting. So the fallback mapping isn't marked as idempotent with tokenization. Maybe we need to pin normalization to primary locale when mixed-script detected.

eval-bot: New eval run queued: job/6642 — locale-suite (oasis-v2 q8x2) — ETA 12m

raj: Can you add a small reproducer and post to /evals for quick bisect? I'll try swapping normalization order + run quant kernel shadow.

hao: Reproducer gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/locale-cldr-repro (contains shell cmd and minimal prompt set). Added to the bisect queue.

elaine: If it's a mapping set issue, we can also experiment with forcing CLDR canonicalization only for CJK primary locales. I'll throw a patch to branch and run smoke.

sophia: Also add a check in the onboarding checklist: "ensure locale fallback does not change token boundaries" — we missed that for oasis-v2.

hao: Agreed. For now, rolling oasis-v2 to canary with fallback disabled for locale_chain tests. Will update when bisect finishes.

raj: Thanks. cc @matt (runtime) in case kernel selection matters here.

matt: noted, I'll watch the bisect logs and kernel perf diffs. If quant kernels amplify spacing insertions, we may need kernel-level token merging heuristics.

hao: Updated: bisect pinned to CLDR mapping table v1.12 -> v1.11 shows regression introduced in mapping changes. Patch incoming.

sophia: Nice find. Please include a short blurb in the release notes about the CLDR mapping change and the mitigation.

hao: Will do. End of thread.
